notes:
Account profile: Azimuth is a global enterprise SaaS org (search layer for large retailers + knowledge teams). Priority: massive-scale semantic index + deterministic reranking.

Key constraints / asks (direct from CTO): 
- Must support 100M -> 1B+ vectors in first year, predictable unit costs.
- Query pattern: hybrid: low-latency (<50ms median) simple recall path + expensive cross-encoder rerank for top-20.
- Throughput target: sustained 6k qps across global regions; occasional spikes to 25k qps.
- Cost sensitivity: wants < $0.0008 per query units (embeddings + ANN + cross-encoder cost amortized).
- Deployment: VPC-first, eventual on-prem option for EU retail customers; strict data residency (EU) on roadmap.
- Security must include SSO (SAML), SOC2-equivalent controls, audit logs, KMS/HSM key separation.

Technical notes from discovery: 
- Current architecture: proprietary ANN layer with HNSW + in-house sharding; uses CPU-heavy retrieval for scale today. Planning to split: ANN on GPU for dense retrieval + cross-encoder on Redwood-dedicated GPUs for rerank.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize for batching/caching suggestions; will test automatic prefix/KV caching to reduce token counts for rerank prompts.
- Careful about cold-start and index rebuild time — wants incremental ingestion and shard rebalancing with minimal impact to tail latency.

Quotes / paraphrases: 
- "We can buy more GPUs, but we need predictable per-query economics and single-pane ops for rollouts." — CTO
- "If we can get the cross-encoder cost down with smart batching/caching, we can flip more customers to semantic-first search." — VP Product

POC plan (agreed): 
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): Ingest 200M vectors from sample product+logs dataset; baseline latency/cost metrics vs current system.
- Phase 2 (2 weeks): Run 2k/5k/10k sustained qps with top-20 retrieval + cross-encoder rerank; evaluate tail p95/p99 latency.
- Acceptance criteria: p50 <= 50ms for recall-only, p95 <= 350ms for full retrieval+rerank at 10k qps; unit cost below target range.

Documents shared: pricing deck, security questionnaire, example reranker prompts. Next meeting: 2026-02-24 to agree on ingestion tooling and dedicated GPU SKU.

Shorthand / CRM-style: 
- AE: Ethan leading commercial; SE Lina owns POC; CSM Marcus to onboard once procurement complete.
- Legal: need residency addendum + DPA; procurement timeline ~4-6 weeks post-POC pass.
- Risk: If rerank cost not reduced, they will consider hybrid approach with weaker cross-encoder or 2-stage re-ranking on CPU for tail queries.
